packageRules.description: The kernel, pnpm, slicc-cdp and the wasm command packages move only after the homescoop coordinator certifies them, as in slicc-bios, so Renovate opens their PRs but never merges them.
The kernel devDependency is the floor of the peer range, so it moves by hand with the range; the newest certified kernel is NEWEST_CERTIFIED_KERNEL in ci.yml.
wasm-git 2.55.0-14 and later need kernel ≥ 1.47.1, and the devDependency must run on the floor kernel (1.26.3). Newer certified builds are tested through NEWEST_CERTIFIED_WASM in ci.yml.
